    """

    # --- Get pre-configured resources from the deck ---
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagents = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Protocol parameters ---
    sample_volume = 20    # uL per sample (within 50 uL tip capacity)
    reagent_volume = 10   # uL of reagent per well
    mix_volume = 20       # uL used for mixing (< total well volume of 30 uL)

    try:

            # 1. Pick up a fresh tip for each sample (prevents cross-contamination)
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)

            # 2. Transfer sample: source -> destination
            await lh.aspirate(src_well, vols=[sample_volume])
            await lh.dispense(dst_well, vols=[sample_volume])
